name: GA3.5 cancel is offered during a request and aborts it
js: (async()=>{const i=document.getElementById('chat-input');i.value='summarise the weather data for the week please';submitMessage();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20));const shown=document.getElementById('cancel-btn').style.display==='inline-block';cancelRequest();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));const hidden=document.getElementById('cancel-btn').style.display==='none';const said=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.warning-bar')).some(b=>/cancelled/i.test(b.textContent));return shown && hidden && said;})()

name: GA3.6 a real reply arrives, and thumbs-down asks 'What went wrong?'
js: (async()=>{const i=document.getElementById('chat-input');i.value='summarise the weather data for the week please';submitMessage();let down=null;for(let k=0;k<60 && !down;k++){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));const bs=document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label="Mark as not helpful"]');down=bs.length?bs[bs.length-1]:null;}if(!down)return 'no reply with feedback buttons';down.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));const inp=document.querySelector('.feedback-comment input');return !!inp && inp.placeholder==='What went wrong?';})()
